title: Help Center
subtitle: Find answers to frequently asked questions here.
signedInHelpTitle: You are viewing the public help center
signedInHelpDesc: This page is available to everyone. Return to the app whenever you are ready to keep working.
faq1Answer: Please ensure the uploaded image is clear, evenly lit, and not distorted. Scans are preferred over photos.
faq2Answer: We currently primarily support piano fingerings and will add more instruments in the future.
faq3Title: What file formats are supported for import/export?
faq3Answer: We primarily support MusicXML for import and export, which is the standard format for digital scores. You can also export the final score as a PNG image.
faq4Title: How does the practice mode work?
faq4Answer: The practice mode listens to your performance in real-time through your device's microphone, compares it to the score, and provides instant feedback on your pitch and rhythm.
